title: Read-only exploration of the Rust workspace in the current directory (aura-harness). Keep it short and fast: aim to fin…
summary: I answered all three from the code and changed nothing. In short: the store is RocksDB, and the "last active" lookup decodes the whole latest entry. The desktop window applies commands as soon as they arrive; the terminal UI applies them within about 5 ms but only draws every 50 ms. Perf tests are plain `#[ignore = "benchmark"]` tests that print timings, with no criterion.
